instruction: This video is upside down. Please fix it and save the corrected version as 'Commercial_Upright.mp4' on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires fixing an upside-down video (180° rotation) in VLC. Evaluator verifies the CORRECT transformation by: (1) checking file was re-encoded, (2) extracting corner pixel regions from source and output videos at timestamp 1s, (3) verifying corners swapped positions consistent with 180° rotation (top-left ↔ bottom-right, top-right ↔ bottom-left). This ensures the video was actually rotated 180°, not just any arbitrary transformation.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies file creation with correct filename 'Commercial_Upright.mp4'
Corner pixel hash approach (metrics/vlc.py:183-230) correctly verifies 180° rotation by checking diagonal corner swaps
For 180° rotation, corners swap diagonally: TL↔BR, TR↔BL, BL↔TR, BR↔TL - exactly as implemented
This approach distinguishes 180° rotation from other transformations (90° rotation would have different corner movement pattern, mirroring would swap horizontally/vertically not diagonally)
Allows 3/4 corner matches for compression tolerance (line 223-226), which is reasonable
Verifies re-encoding occurred through file size difference check
Complete coverage: checks both file creation AND correct transformation semantics
Implementation is robust with proper error handling and detailed logging
